synoptic_justification: 2020 Labor Day extreme offshore East/NE downslope wind event (Klamath/Siskiyou Mountains, sustained 12-18 m/s, gusts 22-28 m/s; continuous 32.6x run from 1,515.7 ha at t0 to 5,512.7 ha (+3h), 13,989.9 ha (+6h), 26,006.6 ha (+12h), and 49,360.4 ha (+24h) across Happy Camp WUI & Klamath River)

Northern Sierra / Plumas NF dry cold-frontal SW wind breakout (sustained 9-14 m/s, gusts 18-23 m/s; unsuppressed 4.2x run from 3,924.7 ha at t0 to 6,143.8 ha (+3h), 6,647.6 ha (+6h), and 16,514.9 ha (+12h/+24h))

Modoc Plateau / Lassen County high-desert SW wind-driven grass/shrub run (sustained 10-15 m/s, gusts 19-24 m/s; 1,746.7 ha at t0 -> 3,477.6 ha (+3h) -> 4,348.3 ha (+6h) -> 6,249.0 ha (+12h) -> 6,821.5 ha (+24h) -> 13,203.5 ha (+30h/+48h))
